statement: The electricity bill record lists an amount due of 18,200 USD, which is inconsistent with the stated 1,300 kWh usage at 0.14 USD/kWh (which equals 182 USD) and with the prior bills of 96–205 USD, so I will not pay the erroneous figure. Please verify the bill with the utility before any payment is made.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the 18,200 figure is "inconsistent" with 1,300 kWh × 0.14 = "182 USD" and refuses to pay it.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
